command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj P3.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: The same operation in two legal encodings: 05 id (the rax form) and 81 /0 id. The encoder never chooses between them; the plan names the form. llvm-mc always picks the rax short form when the destination is rax, so the 81 /0 half is measured on rbx; the 81 /0 encoding with rax is decode-verified in EXP-0004.
